collection.title: Mercedes-Benz G Class 2024 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz G Class Coupe 2024 Onwards (465) will fit, this model requires a 17" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Mercedes-Benz Specific Fit arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
